description: Only teams that have `manager_half` records are included.

c.request: For each team, what is its average half-season win rate (wins `w` divided by games managed `g` for each `manager_half` record, averaged and ignoring missing values) and how many `manager_half` records does it have? Also show how far its average is above the mean of all the team averages (ignoring missing ones, and only if that mean exists). List `team_id`, average win rate, record count and the difference, sorted by the difference from highest to lowest with missing values last, top 10. Only teams that have `manager_half` records are included.
c.sql:
WITH team_win_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    AVG(CASE WHEN w IS NOT NULL AND g IS NOT NULL AND g > 0 THEN CAST(w AS FLOAT) / g ELSE NULL END) as avg_win_rate,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM manager_half
  GROUP BY team_id
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) as mean_value
  FROM team_win_rates
  WHERE avg_win_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  t.team_id,
  t.avg_win_rate,
  t.record_count,
  t.avg_win_rate - o.mean_value as difference
FROM team_win_rates t
CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  difference DESC
LIMIT 10;

b.request: For each team_id in manager_half, compute average win rate (mean of w/g across its records), count of manager_half records, and how much this average exceeds the mean of all team averages, sorted by this difference descending (top 10).
b.sql:
WITH team_win_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    COUNT(*) as record_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN g > 0 THEN CAST(w AS FLOAT) / g ELSE NULL END) as avg_win_rate
  FROM manager_half
  GROUP BY team_id
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) as mean_win_rate
  FROM team_win_rates
)
SELECT 
  twr.team_id,
  twr.avg_win_rate,
  twr.record_count,
  (twr.avg_win_rate - om.mean_win_rate) as difference
FROM team_win_rates twr
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
b.raw: For each team_id in manager_half, compute average win rate (mean of w/g across its records), count of manager_half records, and how much this average exceeds the mean of all team averages, sorted by this difference descending (top 10).

a.request: For each team that appears in `manager_half`, compute its average win rate (wins `w` divided by games managed `g` for each `manager_half` record, averaged and ignoring missing values) and its number of `manager_half` records. Then take the mean of those team averages across teams (ignoring missing ones), and, provided that mean exists, show each team's `team_id`, average win rate, record count, and its average minus that mean, sorted by the difference from highest to lowest with missing values last, top 10.
a.sql:
WITH team_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN w IS NOT NULL AND g IS NOT NULL AND g > 0 
             THEN CAST(w AS FLOAT) / CAST(g AS FLOAT) 
             ELSE NULL END) AS avg_win_rate
  FROM manager_half
  GROUP BY team_id
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_avg_win_rate
  FROM team_stats
  WHERE avg_win_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ts.team_id,
  ts.avg_win_rate,
  ts.record_count,
  ts.avg_win_rate - om.mean_avg_win_rate AS diff_from_mean
FROM team_stats ts
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE om.mean_avg_win_rate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN ts.avg_win_rate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  ts.avg_win_rate - om.mean_avg_win_rate DESC
LIMIT 10;

d.request: For each team with manager_half records, calculate the average of (wins divided by games) for all its non-null manager_half records, count those records, find the difference between each team's average and the overall mean of all team averages, and return team_id, average win rate, record count, and difference sorted by difference descending with missing values last for the top 10.
d.sql:
WITH team_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    AVG(CAST(w AS NUMERIC) / CAST(g AS NUMERIC)) as avg_win_rate,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM manager_half
  WHERE w IS NOT NULL AND g IS NOT NULL AND g > 0
  GROUP BY team_id
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) as mean_win_rate
  FROM team_stats
)
SELECT 
  ts.team_id,
  ts.avg_win_rate,
  ts.record_count,
  ts.avg_win_rate - om.mean_win_rate as difference
FROM team_stats ts
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
